p: BENI-OCEAN is a nature education organization that uses the ocean as its setting. Through marine ecosystem conservation activities and ocean sports, we aim to develop participants into ocean guardians who draw strength from the sea, build resilience, and foster courage.
pc: 心海沁洋是以海洋为场域的自然教育机构，我们以海洋生态保护行动和海洋运动为内容，培养参与者成为海洋守护者，从大海中获得力量，培养韧性，激发勇气。
